scope: UR2: Flutter, Dart and Android tools resolve and run in the signed-in user's environment (ANDROID_HOME, ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, LOCALAPPDATA) and as that user

libraries.verified: 2026-11-08 UR2: Context7 returns no passage for ANDROID_HOME (gap; the Android developer page used). ANDROID_HOME is the variable many tools read to find the Android SDK installation directory, so Talvora reads it, ANDROID_SDK_ROOT and the default %LOCALAPPDATA%\Android\Sdk from the signed-in user's environment instead of the service account's; the machine-target reads stay because machine values are the same for every account.
